facts.raw_span: stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma
metastases of the liver, lungs, and peritoneum
Photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
Diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, involving nasolabial folds
Erythema and edema of upper eyelids
Creatine kinase: 1088 U/L
Antinuclear antibody titer: 1:640 with speckled pattern
Jo-1 antibody: negative
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis
Grade 4/5 strength on resisted abduction of shoulders bilaterally
Limited flexion of both hips

support_spans: Photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
Diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, involving nasolabial folds
Erythema and edema of upper eyelids
Flat-topped pink to erythematous papules over knuckles
Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
concepts.why: The presence of skin symptoms such as photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption and flat-topped papules, along with muscle weakness and elevated creatine kinase levels, earned this slot.

support_spans: stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma
Photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
concepts.why: The association of dermatomyositis with malignant melanoma, particularly with the B-RAF V600E mutation, earned this slot.

support_spans: Within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment, she developed skin symptoms
concepts.why: The temporal relationship between ipilimumab treatment and the development of skin symptoms earned this slot.

support_spans: Creatine kinase: 1088 U/L
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
concepts.why: The presence of muscle weakness, elevated creatine kinase levels, and MRI findings of muscle inflammation earned this slot.

support_spans: Antinuclear antibody titer: 1:640 with speckled pattern
concepts.why: The presence of a high antinuclear antibody titer with a speckled pattern, along with muscle weakness and elevated creatine kinase levels, earned this slot.
The negative Jo-1 antibody result does not rule out Anti-Synthetase Syndrome, which can present with similar clinical features and muscle biopsy findings.

frontier_selector.why: The temporal relationship between ipilimumab treatment and the development of skin symptoms, as well as the presence of characteristic dermatomyositis skin findings, decided the diagnosis.
